# Employee Benefits Summary 2026

Effective January 1, 2026, for all Acme Digital employees, in Argentina and in our remote hubs (Montevideo, Santiago, Mexico City and Bogotá). Independent contractors are not eligible for these benefits. Vacation and leave rules live in the vacation and leave policy, not here. Owner: People & Culture (Florencia Ibarra).

## Health plan

- Argentina: private prepaid health coverage from your first day, at no cost to you, for you, your spouse or partner and your children under 25.
- Parents can be added to the plan at your own cost, with a 30% discount on the list price.
- Outside Argentina: a monthly health allowance of USD 120, or USD 180 if you have dependents, paid with your salary so you can choose a local plan.
- Changes to your family group are made with People & Culture within 30 days of the event (marriage, birth, adoption).

## Gym stipend

You get USD 40 per month for physical activity: gym, yoga, swimming, climbing, running clubs or any sports club. Submit the receipt through Proseware Expenses by the 5th of the following month and it is paid with your next salary. Unused months do not accumulate.

## Learning budget

- Each person has USD 800 per calendar year for courses, certifications, books and conferences.
- Your lead approves the spend before you buy; payment is direct or by reimbursement through Proseware Expenses.
- Platform certifications (Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Meta and HubSpot) are covered in full and do not count against the USD 800.
- Unused budget does not roll over to the next year.
- If you leave Acme within 6 months of a course that cost more than USD 500, you repay 50% of it.

## English classes

Group English classes run twice a week, on Mondays and Wednesdays from 9:00 to 10:00 Buenos Aires time, by video call with an in-house teacher. Levels go from A2 to C1, with a placement test in March and August. Keep at least 80% attendance to keep your spot; leads can request two months of one-on-one conversation practice before a client presentation in English.

## Referral bonus

- USD 1,000 for every referral we hire, paid with the payroll after the new person completes 90 days.
- USD 1,500 for hard-to-fill roles: senior Data and senior E-commerce development.
- Send referrals to People & Culture before the candidate applies on their own; the first referral received wins.
- Heads of area are not eligible for hires into their own area.

## Home-office kit

New employees receive a one-time home-office kit worth up to USD 450: an ergonomic chair, a desk lamp and a monitor arm, delivered by Wide World Logística during the first month. You can opt for reimbursement instead if you already have some items. The kit can be renewed every 3 years. Peripherals such as keyboards and webcams are covered separately under the hybrid work policy.

## Wellness days

- 3 wellness days per calendar year, on top of your vacation days, to rest or take care of yourself; no reason needed.
- Request them in the "Ausencias" form in Notion with at least 48 hours' notice.
- They cannot be attached to vacation days or bridge holidays, and they do not carry over.
- Summer Fridays: during January and February, the workday ends at 14:00 on Fridays.

## Other perks

- Lunch on office days: covered up to ARS 15,000 per person per day.
- Year-end gift box from Coho for every employee, shipped in December.
- Anniversary gift: on your 5th anniversary at Acme, a USD 300 experience voucher (a dinner, a trip or a course of your choice).
